content: create_hypertable() partitions on a single time column; additional columns (device_mac, dst_ip) become part of a composite PRIMARY KEY alongside time, not separate hypertable dimensions, unless space-partitioning is explicitly added (rarely needed at single-household scale). bandwidth_metrics' PK (time, device_mac) is the standard pattern; traffic_flows should follow PK (time, device_mac, dst_ip, dst_port, protocol).
